review_summary: Comprehensive Review (Chidzidzo 35) consolidates Lessons 29, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34. Key structures mastered in this block include Zezuru alliterative subject/object concords (zvivakashure), agglutinative tense/aspect markers (-no- habitual, -ka- past, -cha- future), and high/low tone patterns across: 1st Person Sg Subject Concord (ndi-); Mupanda 16 Locative Prefix (pa-); Mupanda 5/9 Nominal or Verbal Stem; Mupanda 7/1a Title Noun. Example utterances reviewed: "ndinorwadziwa panguva dzepabonde ndinganoona chiremba here kuti ndibatsirwe handichaziva kuti chii chiri kuitika pandiri" | "ndichangoziva kuti ndakazvitakura asi handizive kuti ndotanga kudii ndingabatsirikawo sei nekuti hapana zvandinoziva" | "ndirikuona senge ndirikuita discharge inoratidza kusiyana uye zve ine munhuhwi wakatosiyana nezvemazuva ose"

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'ndinorwadziwa panguva dzepabonde ndinganoona chiremba here kuti ndibatsirwe handichaziva kuti chii chiri kuitika ______' (Community health consultation in Zezuru: 'ndinorwadziwa panguva dzepabonde ndinganoona chiremba here kuti ndibatsirwe hand')
review_exercises.explanation: 'pandiri' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'ndichangoziva kuti ndakazvitakura asi handizive kuti ndotanga kudii ndingabatsirikawo sei nekuti hapana ______' (Expectant mother's health inquiry in Zezuru: 'ndichangoziva kuti ndakazvitakura asi handizive kuti ndotanga kudii ndingabatsir')
review_exercises.explanation: 'zvandinoziva' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'ndirikuona senge ndirikuita discharge inoratidza kusiyana uye zve ine munhuhwi wakatosiyana nezvemazuva ______' (Zezuru utterance (I am [kuona] / senge / I am [kuita] / discharge / it (Cl. 9) habitually [ratidza] / to (infinitive) / towards [siyana] / uye / zve))
review_exercises.explanation: 'ose' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'ndingadawo kuziva mushonga inokurudzirwa kumwiwa kunyaradza marwadzo akaita semusoro kana kudziya muviri kana ______' (My head is aching severely during my pregnancy and is not getting better; what medicine can I safely take?)
review_exercises.explanation: 'ndakazvitakura' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'ndakanzwa kuti madzimai anokurudzirwa kunoongororwa cervical cancer kuchipatara ndingadawo kuziva kuti zvinofamba ______' (Community health consultation in Zezuru: 'ndakanzwa kuti madzimai anokurudzirwa kunoongororwa cervical cancer kuchipatara ')
review_exercises.explanation: 'sei' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'mwana wangu haasi kufema zvakanaka arikuto fema nemukamwa uye arikufema achikasika ndakutonetsekana kuti ______' (My child is not breathing well and is breathing through the mouth; what urgent care is needed?)
review_exercises.explanation: 'ndodii' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.
